findings.fix: State IsPathConnected (C \ {p}) and prove it with IsPathConnected.image' on (Circle.isPathConnected_compl_singleton _), dropping the .isConnected downgrade.
findings.issue: IsJordanCurve.isConnected_diff_singleton concludes only IsConnected, but the proof draws Circle.isPathConnected_compl_singleton and downgrades via .isConnected before taking the image; the docstring calls the result an 'arc'. Path-connectedness is the natural, stronger conclusion.

findings.evidence: `hcon` is built from `isConnected_Ioo` and `.image`; Ioo is convex hence path connected (Convex.isPathConnected, Mathlib/Analysis/Convex/PathConnected.lean:85).
findings.fix: Return IsPathConnected A/B: build hcon via (convex_Ioo _ _).isPathConnected …).image', then transport with IsPathConnected.image'. The sphere corollaries then strengthen automatically.
findings.issue: exists_isOpen_isConnected_union_eq_compl_pair_circle and IsJordanCurve.exists_isConnected_union_eq_diff_pair give IsConnected A/B, but each arc is a continuous image of Ioo 0 1 (path connected), so A and B are path connected; under-generalized.

summary: The new results conclude IsConnected where IsPathConnected is freely available and more natural: the arcs are continuous images of the path-connected Ioo/circle-complement, and the docstrings themselves call them arcs. Otherwise assumptions and the general-vs-special-case structure sit at the right level.
